dedupe_keys.name: usda rma crop insurance cause of loss data summary of business

description: The Risk Management Agency, which manages the Federal Crop Insurance Corporation, publishes crop insurance participation broken down by cause of loss as part of its Summary of Business. Each crop year from 1989 to 2026 is a ZIP file of pipe-delimited flat files that can be loaded into spreadsheets or databases, with a record layout for all years in PDF and Word, and the Summary of Business with month of loss. Files summarise participation by cause of loss, and the AgRisk Viewer shows them by commodity, cause of loss and county. Access is free. The AgRisk Viewer of the USDA Southwest Climate Hub maps the same public files by commodity, cause, metric and period, with county detail and downloads. No licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: data cover insured crops only, and causes are those reported on claims. For simulation it gives a long county-level record of weather-related crop losses for vulnerability curves, hazard-loss calibration and agricultural resilience analyses. Related catalogue records include USDA NASS Quick Stats and the USDA Cropland Data Layer.
